segments.name: Capsule Endoscopy
segments.description: Develops and sells single-use capsule endoscopy systems and associated software for visualizing the GI tract to gastroenterologists in clinics and hospitals.
segments.evidence: Currently, our GI-tract capsule endoscopy solution comprises our single-use CapsoCam capsule and the associated software, CapsoCloud and CapsoView.

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue from sales of CapsoCam Plus capsules, primarily to gastroenterologists through its in-house sales team and, outside the U.S., qualified distributors.
revenueModel.evidence: We currently sell CapsoCam Plus capsules in the U.S. to our customers, which primarily include gastroenterologists practicing in clinics and/or hospitals, primarily through our in-house sales team.
